666563.rationale: Xi visited Pyongyang June 8-9, 2026; both sides 'decided to jointly commemorate' the treaty's 65th anniversary (July 11). Jo Yong Won is now SPA Standing Committee chairman, so an NPC-linked Politburo figure (Li Hongzhong led the 2023 armistice delegation; Zhao Leji held talks with the SPA chairman in April 2024) is the most natural counterpart. No delegation had been announced as of June 24.
666563.next_info: Xinhua/KCNA announcement of a Chinese 'party and government delegation' for the treaty anniversary, typically 1-3 days before (around July 8-11).

202511.rationale: Gen. Ye Win Oo (C-in-C since March 30, 2026) had made no foreign trips by June 24; he stayed home during President Min Aung Hlaing's June 15 state visit to China. Russia (arms partner; August defence events) and China (main patron) are the most likely first hosts, with Thailand as the neighbour option.
202511.next_info: Myanmar state media (MITV/GNLM) or Irrawaddy reports of any C-in-C trip, especially to Russia's August defence forums or a PLA invitation (July-early August).

709570.rationale: Suu Kyi was moved to house arrest in late April 2026. ASEAN chair Philippines formally asked for 'brief access' for special envoy Theresa Lazaro (May 6), but there was no access by June 22 and her lawyers have been barred since 2023. Naypyitaw wants to re-engage ASEAN, so an ASEAN envoy visit is the main path, but the junta's refusal record is strong.
709570.next_info: ASEAN Foreign Ministers' Meeting (July 2026); Lazaro's Myanmar trips; ASEAN summit (Oct/Nov 2026); any Myanmar statement on envoy access.

971524.rationale: Thailand hosts about 80,000+ Myanmar refugees in nine border camps and has drafted a camp-closure and long-term plan since August 2025. Engagement with Myanmar's new 'civilian' government makes a finalized voluntary-return first phase plausible. Malaysia, which hosts Rohingya/Chin refugees, is the alternative. Bangladesh is excluded because it is not in Southeast Asia.
971524.next_info: Thai NSC/Interior Ministry or MFA statements on refugee returns; Thai-Myanmar bilateral meetings in July-August 2026.

581343.rationale: Election Sept 13 (notice Aug 27) is a de facto two-way race between incumbent Denny Tamaki (66, All Okinawa, seeking a rare third term) and Genta Koja (42, ex-Naha deputy mayor, LDP-backed, DPFP recommending). Komeito is leaning away from Tamaki. Trends against Tamaki: the LDP's Feb 2026 landslide, the March 2026 Henoko protest-boat capsizing that killed 2 students, Washington-office scandal and fatigue. No polls found.
581343.next_info: Komeito's endorsement decision; media polls (Ryukyu Shimpo/Okinawa Times/OTV) in late August-early September; candidate notice Aug 27.

927657.rationale: The Ba'ath-era National Security Bureau was dissolved in 2024-25, so a July 2026 appointment implies a re-created coordinating body. The most plausible heads are al-Sharaa's top security men: Interior Minister Anas Khattab (ex-GIS chief, 'real spymaster') or GIS director Hussein al-Salama. No reporting found as of June 24.
927657.next_info: SANA presidential decrees in July 2026 on security restructuring; any interior-minister or GIS reshuffle.

126882.rationale: The OPCW's May 26-27, 2026 report found dozens of undeclared chemical munitions near Hama, Homs and Latakia. These include aerial bombs of the type used at Ltamenah and Khan Shaykhun in 2017, and rockets of the type used in the 2013 Ghouta attack. The first destruction will likely target one of these two types; aerial bombs are the headline category.
126882.next_info: OPCW monthly Syria reports (late June, late July, late August) and the DG's report to the UNSC by Sept 3.

882554.rationale: The first government-opposition meeting was on June 18, 2026: Jorge Rodriguez (NA president, Delcy Rodriguez's delegate) and US-backed Dinorah Figuera. It set up a parity 'technical and political table' explicitly aimed at a 'credible CNE', i.e. the electoral branch (Poder Electoral). Rubio has called for a 'new electoral committee'.
882554.next_info: Outcomes of the parity working-table sessions (July-August); any announced agreement to renew the CNE / Poder Electoral; Machado camp's parallel 'Panama Manifesto' track.

415011.rationale: Keiko Fujimori has an unbeatable lead (JNE proclamation expected mid-July; inauguration July 28) and promises a broad, plural, experienced cabinet. Leaked names cover MEF (Luis Carranza), Interior, Defense and Agriculture, but no foreign-minister name has surfaced. The picks are experienced diplomats, including ex-FMs Hugo de Zela and Gonzalez-Olaechea, and current FM Carlos Pareja, whom the left calls close to fujimorismo.
415011.next_info: PM announcement after JNE proclamation (mid-July); full cabinet swearing-in July 28-29.

846721.rationale: Sinaloa's Congress named Yeraldine Bonilla Valverde interim governor on May 2, 2026. Rocha Moya's leave is indefinite and changes only if he formally returns or resigns. A return is unlikely given the US indictment; if he resigned, a substitute would be named, and Bonilla would likely be retained.
846721.next_info: Any Rocha Moya resignation or return notice to the Sinaloa Congress; FGR investigation developments; US extradition moves.

880660.rationale: An STF justice suspending a sitting PF director-general would be unprecedented; the closest precedent is Moraes blocking Ramagem's appointment in 2020. Tensions are rising, though. The opposition demands Andrei's removal over the Master leaks, Ramagem and the delegate swap in the INSS/Lulinha probe, and Mendonca's circle fears the Justice Ministry's recall of seconded PF delegates will hurt the Master/INSS cases he oversees. Mendonca is therefore the most likely issuer if any.
880660.next_info: Any STF petition seeking Andrei's afastamento; Mendonca decisions in the INSS/Master inquiries; whether the MJ formally recalls PF delegates seconded to the STF (July-September).

935351.rationale: The election is on Sept 23, 2026. Akhannouch is not running and has stepped down as RNI leader; Mohamed Chaouki was elected RNI leader in February 2026 and is running in Boulemane. The King appoints the PM from the first-placed party, usually its leader (2021: within 2 days). RNI is the incumbent largest party (102 seats) but was hurt by the Gen Z 212 protests, and PAM (Mansouri) and Istiqlal (Baraka) are contending.
935351.next_info: Campaign developments in September; results on Sept 23-24; royal appointment, likely within days.

685197.rationale: As of June 24 the AJK EC still set a single polling day of July 27 (Monday). The three-phase plan must have come later, amid JAAC unrest concentrated in Rawalakot/Poonch and PPP calls to postpone; Aug 10 is also a Monday. The best guess is division-wise phasing with the troubled Poonch division later. The exact grouping is highly uncertain.
685197.next_info: AJK Election Commission revised (phased) schedule notification, likely late June-July 2026.

984539.rationale: Khan (CRVO in his right eye) has been taken to PIMS for all 5 intravitreal injections (Jan 24, Feb 24, Mar 23, Apr 28, Jun 14), with Al-Shifa Eye Hospital retina specialists involved. The family/PTI petition before the Supreme Court seeks transfer to Shifa International Hospital, and the IHC rejected a private-hospital transfer in March. A court-ordered transfer could follow either the government track (PIMS) or the petition (Shifa International).
984539.next_info: Supreme Court hearings on the Uzma Khan/Imran Khan petitions (July-August); medical board reports.
